{{Quote|The people are cold and hungry. Isn't helping them more important?|Taun, to the Young advisory council|<ref name="TUP" />}}
'''Taun''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Melida/Daan/Legends|Melida/Daan]]. He headed [[the Young]]'s [[Utilities Squad]] after the [[Battle of Zehava (Young–Elders War)|Battle of Zehava]]. Taun was determined to help the citizens of [[Zehava]] left without heat and power as a result of the multiple conflicts of the [[Melida/Daan Civil War]].<ref name="TUP" />
